title: Prime Count Bounded by Nondivisors
statement: Let $y\ne0$ be an integer and let $B,N$ be natural numbers such that $|y|\le2^B$. The number of primes at most $N$ is no greater than the number of integers $v$ with $0\le v<N$ for which $v+1$ does not divide $y$, plus $B$.
